description: Set rigid placement by opaque part_id (translation mm, intrinsic XYZ Euler degrees). One assembly undo step. Fix one base part with a fixed joint, then place every part that touches or attaches to another with joint_create (one call creates the joint and solves placement). Use part_set_transform only for parts that touch nothing. Block-out positions are rough; joints set final positions. In an assembly of two or more parts, placing a part that is in no joint adds warning { code: "unjointed_part", part_id, hint } and does not block the call. A single-part document does not warn, and neither does a base part that already has a fixed joint. A vault path or display name is unknown_part. Working copy only. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

part_id.description: Part id from parts. Not a vault path.

position.description: Translation [x, y, z] in mm. Omitted keeps the current translation. A rough block-out for a part that touches nothing; joint_create places a part that touches another. Block-out positions are rough; joints set final positions.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

rotation.description: Intrinsic XYZ Euler rotation in degrees (same order as three.js Euler XYZ). Omitted keeps the current rotation.

name: part_set_transform
